turns.input: *He looks at Captain Doran Hale, trying to understand what kind of person he has in front of him.*
turns.draft:
Nicco studied the guard captain as the man closed the distance across the square. Hale was tall, easily his own height or better, broad through the shoulders and thickly built with muscle rather than fat, moving with the unhurried economy of someone long used to carrying armor and authority alike. His head was shaved bare, and a pale veteran's scar nicked one eyebrow; his eyes were blue and steady, and they took in the square, the tavern frontage, and Nicco himself in a single unhurried pass. His officer armor was heavy, practical, unpolished service steel, and a longsword rode at his hip. Nothing about him was showy.

Hale stopped a couple of paces off and looked down at Nicco with a flat, assessing expression. "Sir," he said. His voice was level and carried easily. "Captain Doran Hale, West District Guard. Are you all right? You were told to expect me." He left the question hanging without any particular warmth, but without hostility either, waiting.
